svg.title: A coal-fired power plant, and the three layers that answer a change in demand
svg.desc: A cutaway illustration of a coal-fired power plant. Coal is burned in the boiler, the steam it raises spins the turbine, the turbine drives the generator, and a transformer sends the power out on transmission lines. Three layers answer a change in demand. The spinning steel in the first instant, as the extra pull drags on the turbine and generator and slows them down. The governor over the next several seconds, opening the steam valve. Dispatch minutes later, as other plants come up to cover the new load.

text.style: font: 400 15.3px Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; fill: rgb(35,31,32);
font: 400 15.3px Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; fill: rgb(35,31,32);

text.tspan: The extra pull drags on the spinning turbine and slows it down.
The lost speed opens the governor valve until the turbine pushes back.
Other plants come up to cover the new load.

svg.text: Base illustration by the Tennessee Valley Authority, public domain. Layer annotations added.
